# 2026-09-18 — Volunteer Huddle

> Status: reviewed. Participants: Maya, Jo, and four desk volunteers.

## Observations

The return procedure was repeated verbally at every shift change. That is a reusable training problem, not a change to the loan term. Volunteers wanted one card for identifying a returned tool, inspecting it, and recording the return time.

## Outcome

Move those steps into the [mounted Volunteer Handbook](../../handbook/check-in/README.md). The project [borrowing policy](../kb/borrowing-policy.md) retains the local term and unresolved exceptions.
